item.flashlight.name: Flashlight
item.flashlight.description: Casts a beam in the direction you face. Needs two matching Dry Cells or Battery Packs in its two slots, and keeps working while you use other tools.
item.battery.name: Dry Cell
item.battery.description: Powers a flashlight, two at a time. Right-click a flashlight with it to load it.
recipe.battery.name: Dry Cell
tooltip.empty-in-use: Slots are empty because a pair is in use. Load another to keep it going.
tooltip.empty-none: No batteries. Load two matching ones.
mail.robin.title: New at the shop
mail.robin.text: Dear @,^^A flashlight came in at the Carpenter's Shop. It lights a beam in front of you after dark and runs on a matching pair of Dry Cells.^^It is {{price}}g and Dry Cells are {{cell}}g each. Come by when I am open.^^   -Robin
mail.both.text: Dear @,^^A flashlight came in at the Carpenter's Shop. It lights a beam in front of you after dark and runs on a matching pair of Dry Cells. Clint has them at the Blacksmith too.^^It is {{price}}g and Dry Cells are {{cell}}g each. Come by when I am open.^^   -Robin
mail.clint.text: Dear @,^^I have a flashlight in the shop now. It throws a beam in front of you after dark and runs on a matching pair of Dry Cells.^^It is {{price}}g and Dry Cells are {{cell}}g each. Stop by when I am open.^^   -Clint
gmcm.mail.name: Letter about the flashlight
gmcm.mail.tip: One letter about the flashlight, a few days into a save, to a player who has none. It comes from Robin, from Clint if only he sells it, and it is only sent while a shop sells it.
message.no-battery: The flashlight needs two matching batteries. Right-click it with Dry Cells or Battery Packs to load them.
message.match: Both batteries must be the same kind.
message.one-flashlight: You can only use one flashlight at a time.
message.carry-one: You can only carry one flashlight.
gmcm.key.name: Toggle key
gmcm.key.tip: The button that switches the flashlight on and off. You can list several, such as F, LeftShoulder.
gmcm.beam.name: Beam length
gmcm.beam.tip: How far the beam reaches, in tiles.
gmcm.hours.name: Dry Cell pair life (hours)
gmcm.hours.tip: In-game hours a pair of Dry Cells lasts while it is dark where you are.
gmcm.hand.name: Show in hand
gmcm.hand.tip: Draw the flashlight in the farmer's hand while it is the selected item.
gmcm.shadows.name: Beam shadows
gmcm.shadows.tip: Trees, boulders, buildings and walls stop the beam and throw a shadow behind them, instead of being lit all the way through.
gmcm.packs.name: Allow Battery Packs
gmcm.packs.tip: Let the game's Battery Pack be loaded as a cell that lasts longer and shines brighter. Packs already loaded keep working if this is turned off.
gmcm.packhours.name: Battery Pack pair life (hours)
gmcm.packhours.tip: In-game hours a pair of Battery Packs lasts while it is dark where you are.
gmcm.packbeam.name: Battery Pack beam
gmcm.packbeam.tip: How long the beam is while a Battery Pack is in use, as a percentage of the normal beam.
gmcm.flicker.name: Random flicker
gmcm.flicker.tip: About how many seconds of use pass between random flickers. The beam always flickers more as the charge runs out.
gmcm.shop.tip: Prices and stock take effect once the settings are saved.
gmcm.sold.name: Sold at Robin's
gmcm.sold.tip: Turn this off if another mod decides where the flashlight is sold.
gmcm.blacksmith.name: Sold at Clint's
gmcm.blacksmith.tip: Also sells the flashlight and Dry Cells at Clint's Blacksmith. It can be on together with Robin's, or on its own. With both on, the daily Dry Cell stock is shared between the two shops.
gmcm.price.name: Flashlight price
gmcm.cellprice.name: Dry Cell price
gmcm.stock.name: Dry Cells sold per day
gmcm.stock.tip: How many cells one player can buy in a day. They are used two at a time. With Robin and Clint both selling, the number is shared between the two shops.
gmcm.carry.name: Most Dry Cells carried
gmcm.carry.tip: The shop stops selling to a player who carries this many.
gmcm.out.name: Chance of no stock
gmcm.out.tip: The chance that Robin has no Dry Cells on a day.
gmcm.low.name: Chance of half stock
gmcm.low.tip: The chance that Robin has half the usual Dry Cells on a day.
